notes: Investigation authorized by owner after parity stop. Original explained flags and 31.25% signal-match score are retained.
19 manual liquidations are documented operations, not missing indicator signals; none were removed from the registered denominator.
AEE reproduces with the pre-deployment 120-day lookback; September 29 log reports 83 bars.
ALL and ARES remain unverified against the exact historical signal inputs. Partial-bar sensitivity is a plausible mechanism, not accepted parity evidence.
The audit remains stopped. No studies, live operations or brief changes were performed.

manual_liquidations.status: documented owner-directed operations, outside indicator rules

AEE.cause: September 29 run loaded 83 bars (120-day lookback). On that window AEE has an August 18 exit after its July 30 BUY. At 365/500 days its latest exit is July 28, before the BUY. The longer-lookback image was deployed after the September 29 run.
AEE.evidence_status: run log plus current-tape replays and documented deployment timing

ALL.status: plausible mutable/partial-bar effect; exact historical input unverified
ALL.cause: Current October 12 close gives no exit. Substituting the actual October 12 broker snapshot mark produces the exit. Same-day October 13 data also gives an exit. The run log does not preserve as_of or indicator input bars, so these alternatives cannot be distinguished.
ALL.caveat: Broker snapshot price is not proof of the yfinance signal price.

ARES.status: unresolved exact input; partial-bar effect is plausible
ARES.cause: No entry on October 14 or 15 using current 120/365/500-day tape. A 101-point scan of the final close within each session high-low range reproduces an entry at lower intraday prices.
ARES.caveat: Scanned prices are hypothetical. No archived yfinance bar from the decision time was found in the inspected paper logs or tables; this does not explain the order to the registered standard.

loader.status: confirmed code path, historical occurrence for these orders not proven
loader.mechanism: YFinanceDataLoader includes end_date plus one day and labels daily bars at midnight. CachedYFinanceLoader refetches only when the latest bar is older than 1.5 intervals, so a previous partial bar can be reused the next day and later overwritten. fetch_stock_ohlcv retains timestamps <= today midnight, which can include the current session.

backup_check.conclusion: No decision-time October database backup found in the inspected configured backup paths. No restoration attempted. This was a bounded search, not proof that no other archive exists.
